title: KraveBeauty’s festive pop-up aims to sell $1 million of overstock to spotlight beauty industry waste
summary: Along with beauty brands Amika, Aora and Iota, KraveBeauty’s ‘Waste Me Not's’ pop-up in New York City, US, will sell excess inventory and overlooked products to give them a second life

title: L’Oréal US settles hair relaxer cancer claims lawsuit
summary: In the first case of its kind to go to trial, L’Oréal’s US subsidiary reached a settlement with four women who claimed that the use of chemical hair relaxers contributed to their development of gynaecological cancers

title: Space NK names Leanne Rouse CMO
summary: Leanne Rouse has worked on the launch of Beyoncé’s hair care brand Cécred and cult hand sanitiser brand Touchland at Space NK in her expanded role

title: Mona Kattan's Kayali commits $250,000 to Make-A-Wish International
summary: The commitment has been made through the Mona Kattan-founded fragrance brand’s philanthropic arm, Kayali Cares, which was launched in 2025

title: Cosmetics Business picks: 8 lactic scents milky fragrance fans will love
summary: From Bella Hadid’s Orebella to functional fragrance brand The Nue Co. and Mona Kattan’s Kayali, fragrance brands are launching a variety of lactic and milky scents. CB rounds up some of the best milk-inspired fragrance launches for 2026
